name: Track equipment, vehicles and machinery and plan their servicing
summary: Keeps the asset register from Trackunit, turns each planned service that is due into a Work Order job in ServiceM8, turns each failed inspection into a defect job, and queues an overdue reminder for approval. Crons read and draft; a person approves every email.

crons.name: register
crons.summary: Refresh the visible asset register from Trackunit.

crons.name: service-due
crons.summary: Draft a Work Order job for each planned service that is due; queue a reminder for each overdue one (21:30 UTC is 7 or 8 am in eastern Australia).

crons.name: defects
crons.summary: Draft a Work Order job for each failed inspection response in the last two hours.

draft_ops_note: Draft operations reach nobody outside the business: a Work Order job in ServiceM8 that the office sees and the scheduling workflow allocates, and Trackunit reads. The overdue reminder email is a live operation and waits for a person.

trackunit.covers: asset register, planned service status per asset, failed inspection responses

servicem8.covers: Work Order jobs for services and defects; overdue reminder email queued for approval

gaps: MEX CMMS: no folder in the kit and no API operations mapped. Its asset register, work orders and parts stay manual until its API is mapped.
ServiceM8 asset register: the kit has list and update calls for assets but no create call, so Trackunit assets are not copied into ServiceM8.
Trackunit operating hours and fuel (aemp-iso time series): the kit marks these GET operations as writes, so usage logging is not wired. Check that classification before using them.
Parts ordering, compliance and registration renewals, decommissioning, and CMMS service history: not confirmed in the vendor docs read. Office or agent-skill steps.
Sign-off that returns an asset to service: a person decides. No operation is confirmed for it.
Truck GPS and location (Geotab, Trackunit location): not part of this build; the crons do not read positions.
Trackunit array filters (assetIds, inspection statuses) are not used because array query serialisation is unverified; failed statuses are filtered in code.
Every adapter is docs-only until a sandbox account (Trackunit access token, ServiceM8 trial) proves it. The Trackunit token exchange is not built, so an access token must be supplied.
